body.title: fix(registry): accept OCI Image Index in plugin pull
body.body:
Replay of `https://github.com/helm/helm/pull/32887` for triage testing.

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Closes `#32541`. Supersedes `#32548`, carries over `@waterWang`'s commit (kept as is, with them as author) and adds the test `@TerryHowe` asked for there.

Writing that test showed the one-line change is not enough. Once `ocispec.MediaTypeImageIndex` is allowed, the index is pulled, but `processPluginPull` unmarshals the index itself as an `ocispec.Manifest`. It has no `artifactType` and no config, so the pull fails with:

```
expected config media type application/vnd.helm.plugin.v1+json for legacy compatibility, got
```

This adds `pluginManifestFromIndex`: when the pulled root is an image index, it walks `index.Manifests` and uses the first image manifest whose `artifactType` is `application/vnd.helm.plugin.v1+json` (or, for legacy manifests, whose config media type is). The rest of the plugin processing is unchanged. If no entry is a plugin, the error says so instead of the confusing "not found".

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

Tests:
- `TestProcessPluginPull`: plain manifest, index with an unrelated manifest before the plugin one, index without a plugin manifest.
- `HTTPRegistryClientTestSuite/Test_6_PluginImageIndex`: pushes the plugin manifest and an index to the suite registry with oras and runs `PullPlugin` on the index tag. On `main` it fails with `unable to retrieve manifest: sha256:...: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json: not found` (the error from the issue); with `#32548` alone, both index cases fail with the artifact type error above.

`go test ./pkg/registry/ ./pkg/getter/` and `golangci-lint run ./pkg/registry/...` pass.

AI disclosure: written with the help of Claude Code, reviewed and tested by me.

**If applicable**:
- [ ] this PR contains user facing changes (the `docs needed` label should be applied if so)
- [x] this PR contains unit tests
- [x] this PR has been tested for backwards compatibility

commit.message:
fix(registry): accept OCI Image Index in plugin pull

Allow plugin pull to resolve tags that point to an OCI Image Index,
matching the fix already applied to chart pull in PR #31776.

Closes #32541

Signed-off-by: water <672684719@qq.com>

fix(registry): read the plugin manifest from an image index

With the index allowed in the pull, processPluginPull parsed the index
itself as the plugin manifest and failed the artifact type check. Pick
the index entry whose artifact type (or legacy config media type) is the
plugin type, and test the pull against the test registry.

Closes #32541

Signed-off-by: Lucas Barros <lucasbarros.kam@gmail.com>

refactor(registry): reuse one generic client when scanning the index

Co-authored-by: Terry Howe <terrylhowe@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Lucas Barros <lucasbarros.kam@gmail.com>

fix(registry): select the plugin manifest before copying an image index

Copying the whole index pulled the tar+gzip layers of every platform
before the plugin manifest was picked. Map the index to the plugin
manifest through oras MapRoot, so only that manifest and its layers are
copied, and keep reporting the digest the reference resolved to.

Signed-off-by: Lucas Barros <lucasbarros.kam@gmail.com>

@@ -20,8 +20,12 @@ import (
 	"os"
 	"testing"
 
+	ocispec "github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1"
 	"github.com/stretchr/testify/suite"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2"
 	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/content"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/registry/remote/auth"
 )
 
 type HTTPRegistryClientTestSuite struct {
@@ -76,6 +80,39 @@ func (suite *HTTPRegistryClientTestSuite) Test_5_ImageIndex() {
 	suite.Require().NoError(err)
 }
 
+func (suite *HTTPRegistryClientTestSuite) Test_6_PluginImageIndex() {
+	pluginData := []byte("plugin tarball")
+	f := newPluginFixture(suite.T(), pluginData)
+	index := pushJSON(suite.T(), f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeImageIndex, newImageIndex(f.otherManifest, f.pluginManifest))
+	suite.Require().NoError(f.store.Tag(suite.T().Context(), index, "idx"))
+
+	repo, err := remote.NewRepository(suite.DockerRegistryHost + "/testrepo/demo")
+	suite.Require().NoError(err)
+	repo.PlainHTTP = true
+	repo.Client = &auth.Client{Credential: auth.StaticCredential(suite.DockerRegistryHost, auth.Credential{
+		Username: testUsername,
+		Password: testPassword,
+	})}
+	_, err = oras.Copy(suite.T().Context(), f.store, "idx", repo, "idx", oras.DefaultCopyOptions)
+	suite.Require().NoError(err)
+
+	ref := suite.DockerRegistryHost + "/testrepo/demo:idx"
+	var root ocispec.Descriptor
+	pulled, err := suite.RegistryClient.Generic().PullGeneric(ref, pluginPullOptions(&root))
+	suite.Require().NoError(err)
+	suite.Equal(index.Digest, root.Digest)
+	var digests []string
+	for _, desc := range pulled.Descriptors {
+		digests = append(digests, desc.Digest.String())
+	}
+	suite.ElementsMatch([]string{f.pluginManifest.Digest.String(), f.pluginLayer.Digest.String()}, digests)
+
+	result, err := suite.RegistryClient.PullPlugin(ref, "demo")
+	suite.Require().NoError(err)
+	suite.Equal(pluginData, result.PluginData)
+	suite.Equal(index.Digest, result.Manifest.Digest)
+}
+
 func TestHTTPRegistryClientTestSuite(t *testing.T) {
 	suite.Run(t, new(HTTPRegistryClientTestSuite))
 }

 package registry
 
 import (
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"io"
 	"testing"
 
+	ocispec "github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1"
 	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
 	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/content"
+	"oras.land/oras-go/v2/content/memory"
 )
 
 func TestGetPluginName(t *testing.T) {
@@ -85,3 +92,134 @@ func TestGetPluginName(t *testing.T) {
 		})
 	}
 }
+
+func pushJSON(t *testing.T, store *memory.Store, mediaType string, v any) ocispec.Descriptor {
+	t.Helper()
+	data, err := json.Marshal(v)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	return pushBlob(t, store, mediaType, data)
+}
+
+func pushBlob(t *testing.T, store *memory.Store, mediaType string, data []byte) ocispec.Descriptor {
+	t.Helper()
+	desc := content.NewDescriptorFromBytes(mediaType, data)
+	require.NoError(t, store.Push(t.Context(), desc, bytes.NewReader(data)))
+	return desc
+}
+
+func newImageIndex(manifests ...ocispec.Descriptor) ocispec.Index {
+	return ocispec.Index{
+		SchemaVersion: 2,
+		MediaType:     ocispec.MediaTypeImageIndex,
+		Manifests:     manifests,
+	}
+}
+
+// pluginFixture is a store holding a plugin manifest for "demo" and the
+// manifest of an unrelated artifact type, each with one tar+gzip layer
+type pluginFixture struct {
+	store          *memory.Store
+	pluginManifest ocispec.Descriptor
+	pluginLayer    ocispec.Descriptor
+	otherManifest  ocispec.Descriptor
+	otherLayer     ocispec.Descriptor
+}
+
+func newPluginFixture(t *testing.T, pluginData []byte) pluginFixture {
+	t.Helper()
+	f := pluginFixture{store: memory.New()}
+	f.pluginLayer = pushBlob(t, f.store, "application/vnd.oci.image.layer.v1.tar+gzip", pluginData)
+	f.pluginLayer.Annotations = map[string]string{ocispec.AnnotationTitle: "demo-1.0.0.tgz"}
+	f.otherLayer = pushBlob(t, f.store, "application/vnd.oci.image.layer.v1.tar+gzip", []byte("other platform layer"))
+	config := pushBlob(t, f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeEmptyJSON, []byte("{}"))
+	f.pluginManifest = pushJSON(t, f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeImageManifest, ocispec.Manifest{
+		SchemaVersion: 2,
+		MediaType:     ocispec.MediaTypeImageManifest,
+		ArtifactType:  PluginArtifactType,
+		Config:        config,
+		Layers:        []ocispec.Descriptor{f.pluginLayer},
+	})
+	f.otherManifest = pushJSON(t, f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeImageManifest, ocispec.Manifest{
+		SchemaVersion: 2,
+		MediaType:     ocispec.MediaTypeImageManifest,
+		ArtifactType:  "application/vnd.example.other",
+		Config:        config,
+		Layers:        []ocispec.Descriptor{f.otherLayer},
+	})
+	return f
+}
+
+func TestProcessPluginPull(t *testing.T) {
+	pluginData := []byte("plugin tarball")
+
+	client, err := NewClient(ClientOptWriter(io.Discard))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	t.Run("manifest", func(t *testing.T) {
+		f := newPluginFixture(t, pluginData)
+		result, err := client.processPluginPull(&GenericPullResult{
+			Manifest:    f.pluginManifest,
+			MemoryStore: f.store,
+			Ref:         "localhost:5000/plugins/demo:1.0.0",
+		}, f.pluginManifest, "demo")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, pluginData, result.PluginData)
+		assert.Equal(t, f.pluginManifest.Digest, result.Manifest.Digest)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("manifest selected from an image index", func(t *testing.T) {
+		f := newPluginFixture(t, pluginData)
+		index := pushJSON(t, f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeImageIndex, newImageIndex(f.otherManifest, f.pluginManifest))
+		result, err := client.processPluginPull(&GenericPullResult{
+			Manifest:    f.pluginManifest,
+			MemoryStore: f.store,
+			Ref:         "localhost:5000/plugins/demo:idx",
+		}, index, "demo")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, pluginData, result.PluginData)
+		assert.Equal(t, index.Digest, result.Manifest.Digest)
+	})
+}
+
+func TestPluginManifestFromIndex(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Run("plugin manifest", func(t *testing.T) {
+		f := newPluginFixture(t, []byte("plugin tarball"))
+		index := pushJSON(t, f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeImageIndex, newImageIndex(f.otherManifest, f.pluginManifest))
+		desc, err := pluginManifestFromIndex(t.Context(), f.store, index)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, f.pluginManifest.Digest, desc.Digest)
+	})
+
+	t.Run("no plugin manifest", func(t *testing.T) {
+		f := newPluginFixture(t, []byte("plugin tarball"))
+		index := pushJSON(t, f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeImageIndex, newImageIndex(f.otherManifest))
+		_, err := pluginManifestFromIndex(t.Context(), f.store, index)
+		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "image index does not contain a manifest with artifact type "+PluginArtifactType)
+	})
+}
+
+func TestPluginPullOptionsCopiesOnlyThePluginManifest(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := t.Context()
+	f := newPluginFixture(t, []byte("plugin tarball"))
+	index := pushJSON(t, f.store, ocispec.MediaTypeImageIndex, newImageIndex(f.otherManifest, f.pluginManifest))
+	require.NoError(t, f.store.Tag(ctx, index, "idx"))
+
+	var root ocispec.Descriptor
+	opts := pluginPullOptions(&root)
+	dst := memory.New()
+	copied, err := oras.Copy(ctx, f.store, "idx", dst, "", oras.CopyOptions{MapRoot: opts.MapRoot})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	assert.Equal(t, index.Digest, root.Digest)
+	assert.Equal(t, f.pluginManifest.Digest, copied.Digest)
+	for _, desc := range []ocispec.Descriptor{f.pluginManifest, f.pluginLayer} {
+		ok, err := dst.Exists(ctx, desc)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.True(t, ok, "expected %s to be copied", desc.Digest)
+	}
+	for _, desc := range []ocispec.Descriptor{index, f.otherManifest, f.otherLayer} {
+		ok, err := dst.Exists(ctx, desc)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.False(t, ok, "expected %s not to be copied", desc.Digest)
+	}
+}
